info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Education Enrollments Certificates-v1-spec
info.description: The Education Enrollment Certificates Retrieval API provides access to a comprehensive list of certificates associated with student enrollments in educational programs. This endpoint allows developers to efficiently query and retrieve certificate data, which is essential for educational institutions, administrative staff, and education management systems. Typical use cases include verifying student credentials, tracking academic progress, and integrating certificate information into reporting tools. By leveraging this API, consumers can enhance their applications with valuable educational data.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve details of the enrollment certificate for a specific student. It provides necessary information that may be required for verification or administrative purposes.

requestBody.description: Retrieve the certificate details related to the enrollments. This endpoint allows clients to request certificate information based on their enrollment records.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the certificate enrollment details.

ListEducationEnrollmentsCertificatesRequ.description: This schema represents the request body format for the GET operation related to enrollments and certificates.

ListEducationEnrollmentsCertificatesResp.title: Enrollment Certificate Response

status.description: Indicates whether the request was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number associated with the enrollment.

resultId.description: The identifier for the result of the enrollment process.

state.description: The current state of the enrollment certificate.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A descriptive message providing additional information about the request.

audit.description: Audit information about the enrollment certificate creation.

ListEducationEnrollmentsCertificatesResp.description: The response object for retrieving enrollment certificate details.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The user or system that created the enrollment certificate.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the enrollment certificate was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the enrollment certificate was generated automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Information related to the audit of an enrollment's creation.

x-processing-time.description: The time, in milliseconds, taken to process the request. This header helps to measure the performance and efficiency of the API call.
